    Questions
    
    
    
      
    Which materials do you print in?
    PLA and PETG for most pieces, and resin for small, detailed parts. We recommend one when we quote, based on how the piece will be used.
    
      
    Can I send my own 3D model?
    Yes. We accept STL, 3MF and OBJ files. If you only have a sketch or photos, we can model it for you.
    
      
    How long does a job take?
    Your quote includes a timeline. Larger figurines take longer than stands and small parts, and a deadline in your brief helps us plan.
    
      
    Can I change the design after I see the model?
    Yes. You approve the model before printing, and the number of revision rounds is stated in your quote.
    
      
    How do I pay for a mahjong set?
    Send the order request and we confirm the price, colours and delivery with you before you pay.
